notes.title: Tower Alchemist: Defend Khaldoria – Devlog Version 0.12
notes.notes:
🧪 Tower Alchemist: Defend Khaldoria – Devlog Version 0.12


🔥 Major Updates
Soul Lantern Lifetime  
– Soul Lanterns now have a limited duration. Once the timer runs out, they lose their light and can no longer reveal Shrouded enemies.  



Recharge with Mana  
– Spent Soul Lanterns can be recharged with Mana, giving you a new tactical layer in night missions.  




🛠️ Minor Updates
Tutorial 02 adjusted to make it quicker to complete.  


Talent Tooltip improved – now shows clearly what requirements are missing to unlock a talent.  


Shrouded enemies are no longer fully invisible. They now create a subtle distortion effect on the world behind them.  


Bone Splinters have been removed from the game.  




🐞 Bugfixes
Fixed: Tower Range preview did not display the skilled range.  


Fixed: Tower range display and actual targeting range did not match. Towers now use the skilled range correctly.  


Fixed: Enemies stayed slowed after Undergrowth disappeared.  


Fixed strange behavior of Undergrowth when vanishing.  


Fixed: Players in the campaign received too few Skulls as rewards.  
 
[hr][/hr]

💬 Share your feedback!
Try out the new patch and let us know what you think. Join the discussion on our Discord:  
→ https://discord.gg/guqFam7h9v

notes.title: Tower Alchemist: Defend Khaldoria – Devlog Version 0.11
notes.notes:
🧪 Tower Alchemist: Defend Khaldoria – Devlog Version 0.11

🔥 Major Updates

New Feature: Darkness  

Enemies with the “Shrouded” ability are invisible to towers unless they stand in the light of a Soul Lantern.  
A new strategic challenge through restricted visibility.  


Soul Lanterns  

Alchemically placeable light sources that reveal “Shrouded” enemies.  
Essential in dark missions and night levels.  


Night Levels  

Enemies are completely invisible until they enter a Soul Lantern's light.  
Introduced in Singleplayer Levels 4–6.  


🛠️ Minor Updates

Singleplayer Levels 4–6 reworked and enhanced with the new Darkness mechanic.  
New Win/Lose screens with an updated layout and more visual flair.  
New 2D illustrations by Milan and Sofija for story sequences and UI elements.  
New map preview images for Singleplayer Levels 4–6.  
“Undergrowth” now displays the remaining effect time for the last 10 seconds via UI.  
Added brightness settings to the options menu.  
Voice volume can now be adjusted separately in the settings.  
Camera can now be rotated using the middle mouse button.  


🐞 Bugfixes

Fixed: Portal entrances and exits did not correctly change their lighting when enemies passed through.  
Fixed: The campaign Win Screen did not display which star was earned after completing a level.  
Fixed: Ragers could be stunned by the Death Tower even while enraged – not anymore.  
Various minor bugs fixed.  


[hr][/hr]

Ready for the Darkness?

notes.title: Tower Alchemist: Defend Khaldoria – Devlog Version 0.10
notes.notes:
🧪 Tower Alchemist: Defend Khaldoria – Devlog Version 0.10

🔥 Major Updates

New Feature: Alchemy!
– New UI element to apply alchemical vials to the battlefield.  
– First vial: Undergrowth – slows enemies by 33%, cancels sprinting.

Companion System  
– Companions now provide ingredients and vials. Selectable in a new UI panel.

New Stage & Campaign UI  
– Improved overview and navigation for better usability.

Buffed Rage Ability  
– Triggers at 33% HP (was 50%), damage reduction now 80% (was 50%).


🛠️ Minor Updates

“Holy Land” refunds must now be manually collected.  
Improved visibility of refund effect for towers near the Holy Tower.  
MB1 icon animates after story progress.  
Arrows now show enemy movement direction.  
Final wave indicated by sound and UI alert.  
Collectable skulls and gold coins now emit light for better visibility.  
Mana drops from wave 3 in Life and Death level.  
Easy mode: tower refund reduced to 75% (was 100%).  
Various UI improvements.


🐞 Bugfixes

Death Tower souls dealt damage without the required talent – fixed.  
Tower range was displayed as double – fixed.  
Tower building bug after canceling "The Beginning" – fixed.  
Escape menu delay – fixed.  
Roadmap wishlist button had no function – fixed.  
Save states reset to avoid compatibility issues.  
Various minor bug and balance fixes.

notes.title: Tower Alchemist - Version 0.9
notes.notes:
Tower Alchemist: Defend Khaldoria - Devlog Version 0.9

We are excited to present the latest update for Tower Alchemist: Defend Khaldoria! This version introduces exciting new features, improvements, and bug fixes. Your feedback is invaluable, and we are continuously working to enhance the game experience.

[hr][/hr]

Major Updates

New Talents for Death Towers  
Death Towers have received new talents, expanding their strategic options and giving you more ways to optimize your defense.

New Enemy Ability: Frenzied  
Enemies with the Frenzied ability become increasingly dangerous the longer they stay alive. This new mechanic requires even more thoughtful strategies.

Easy Difficulty Added to Single-Player Mode  
We have introduced the Easy difficulty level for single-player mode! This will help newcomers familiarize themselves with the game mechanics more easily.

Tower Explanations Added to the Workshop  
To help you better plan your defenses, we have added detailed explanations of towers and their functions in the Tower Workshop.

New 3D Models for Enemy Types  
The Sprinting and Frenzied enemy types have been given new, improved 3D models, adding even more visual variety to the game.

New Visual Effect for Arrow Tower ‘Rapid Fire’  
The Rapid Fire upgrade for the Arrow Tower now has an improved visual effect, making attacks more dynamic and visually striking.

[hr][/hr]

Minor Updates  
  
 Improved UI design of the Tower Workshop for better clarity.  
 More understandable descriptions of towers and their abilities.  
 New indication of which content will be unlocked in the full version.  
  

[hr][/hr]

Bugfixes  
  
 Fixed incorrect damage value preview in the upgrade tooltip.  
 Fixed an issue where the story did not start after Tutorial 01.  
  

[hr][/hr]

Community Call  
We are still looking for help in translating Tower Alchemist: Defend Khaldoria into more languages! If you're interested in translating the game into your native language, we'd love to hear from you. Your support would be invaluable, and we'd be thrilled to welcome you as part of our team!

notes.title: Demo release 0.8 available
notes.notes:
Tower Alchemist: Defend Khaldoria - Devlog Version 0.8

We are excited to share the latest updates for Tower Alchemist: Defend Khaldoria! Development of this version took longer than originally planned, but we believe that good things take time. Our goal remains to deliver bug-free and optimized versions for our players.

Major Updates

Revamped Talent Tree 
The Talent Tree has been completely revamped and now includes new talents for the Arrow, Cannon, and Holy towers. These talents add more strategic depth to the game, offering new ways to optimize your defenses.

New Single-Player Mode 
We’ve introduced a new single-player mode available at the Normal difficulty level. Additional difficulty levels (Easy and Hard) will be added in Spring 2025.

New Enemies: Corrupted Boar and Forest Dragon 
Two new enemies have been added to the game: the Corrupted Boar and the Forest Dragon. Additionally, enemy abilities are now tied to specific models, making it easier to identify the type of enemy and its abilities at a glance.

Minor Updates

 
 Preparations for additional language translations have been made.
 Added effects for the Sprint and Heal abilities.
 Adjusted balancing for towers and talents.
 Improved fade-in and fade-out transitions between screens.
 Added buff/debuff indicators to towers.
 Building mode can now be exited with a right-click.
 Sprinting enemies now start at random intervals instead of all at once.


Bugfixes

 
 Fixed an issue in Story Mode Level 8 where the level started in Wave 2.
 The Holy Tower now properly stops its channeling sound.
 Credits now scroll correctly.
 Numerous additional bug fixes and optimizations have been implemented.


Community Call
We’re looking for players to help us translate Tower Alchemist: Defend Khaldoria into more languages! If you’re interested in translating the game into your native language, we’d love to hear from you. Your support would mean a lot to us, and we’d be thrilled to have you as part of our team.

notes.title: Demo release 0.7.3 available
notes.notes:
Tower Alchemist: Defend Khaldoria - Devlog Version 0.7.3

We are excited to present the latest updates and improvements for Tower Alchemist: Defend Khaldoria. This version marks a significant milestone for us, as it is the first demo version to be released on Steam and is available to all users.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866380/Tower_Alchemist_Defend_Khaldoria/

Major Updates

Expanded Story and Voice Acting

We have introduced a comprehensive update to the game's story. A total of 412 files were added for two languages and two characters, providing over 45 minutes of voice acting. The story now takes players into the youth of the main protagonist, Milan or Sofija, who must flee their hometown after an attack and seek safety with their mother. This emotional journey ends in the demo with an exciting cliffhanger.

New Talent Tree in "The Tower Workshop"

A new talent tree, "The Tower Workshop," has been implemented. Players can now enhance their towers and give them unique abilities, such as increased range, more damage, faster firing rate, the ability to critically hit, a temporary 50% buff to firing speed, or the chance to stun enemies on hit. More updates to the talent tree will follow in Patch 0.8.

Focus System for Towers

A new focus system has been added, allowing players to manually target specific enemies with towers via right-click or automatically target specific types of enemies, such as those at the front or back, weak or strong targets.

Game Renaming

To avoid potential copyright issues, the game was renamed from "Mystic Towerdefense" to "Tower Alchemist: Defend Khaldoria." The new name better aligns with our vision for the game and avoids legal complications.

Balancing Adjustments

The game's balancing has been revised, making the levels available in the demo version more challenging.

Minor Updates


 Effects: Smoke and fire particle effects were added to the cannon towers.
 Campaign Navigation: The campaign can now be scrolled, allowing players to replay old tower-defense labyrinths.
 Splash Screen: A new splash screen featuring the Weird-Chicken-Games logo and a beta status notice has been added.
 Updated Story Images: The story images have been updated to improve visual quality.
 UI for Roadmap: A new UI element for the game's roadmap has been integrated.
 Fading between story elements has been optimized/fixed.
 A stun system and critical hits have been added.


Bugfixes


 Towers were dealing too much damage to their preferred magic armor type.
 The volume levels of the music and voiceovers have been adjusted.
 A UI issue on 16:10 screens has been fixed.
 Incorrect displays for damage, range, and firing rate for towers have been corrected.
 Issues with subtitle display have been resolved.
 A problem with the laser display of the Life Tower has been fixed.
 The preview of the Death Tower was partially invisible and has been fixed.
 Various tooltip displays have been corrected.
 An error in the targeting calculation for the cannon tower has been fixed.
 A UI error that caused only Level 1 to be playable has been resolved.
 An issue where the voiceover continued despite the level being completed has been fixed.
 An issue that prevented the intro video from playing on Windows 10 devices has been resolved.


We are proud of the progress we have made and look forward to feedback from our community. Your feedback is invaluable to us as it helps us further improve the gaming experience and advance the development of Tower Alchemist: Defend Khaldoria.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866380/Tower_Alchemist_Defend_Khaldoria/
